# BDCrops

> Satellite Intelligence for Bangladesh Agriculture — providing multispectral analysis, water detection, and crop monitoring services for farmers and agribusinesses.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://bdcrops.com/): Main landing page with product overview
- [Demos](https://bdcrops.com/#demos): Live demonstrations of satellite imagery products

## Products
- Multispectral Dashboard: Real-time crop health monitoring
- Water Detection: Field-level water resource mapping
- True Color Imagery: High-resolution satellite views
- NDVI Analysis: Vegetation index monitoring

## Contact
- [Contact Form](https://bdcrops.com/#contact): Get in touch for pilot programs
